Overview

Fujairah is a city in Fujairah with a population of 152,000. The only emirate on the Gulf of Oman, a scenic coastal city known for its mountains, beaches, and the historic Fujairah Fort. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 340 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
